Renderings: the Middle Assyrian Laws, Tablet A (MAL A), project 4 of חוקים-ובריתות/

Contents
  • 1. Formulas and recurring words taken from LH, LE and the corpus
  • 2. MAL words fixed by T2 (§1–§24)
  • 3. MAL words fixed by T3 (§25–§40, file 2 = o iii 82–r v 106)
  • 4. MAL words fixed by T4 (§41–§59, colophon; file 3 = r vi 1–r viii 65)

Binding above this file: the corpus ../renderings.md (§0, §5, §6.1–§6.2), the Laws of Hammurabi's fixed formulas and words (../2-חוקי-חמורבי/renderings.md §1 F1–F43, §2, §4) and the Laws of Eshnunna's decisions (../3-חוקי-אשנונה/renderings.md; project.md Part T1). An Akkadian formula that LH has gets LH's Hebrew letter for letter (../laws_verify.py MAL checks it). This file lists the MAL words and how they were fixed: §1–§24 by T2 (run 6, 2026-10-18); T3 (§25–§40) and T4 (§41–§59, colophon) extend it (add rows, never change a row without recording it in their Part section). Plain plene Hebrew as it must appear in the > lines; vocalized forms strip to it.

Columns: Akkadian (ORACC norm; CDA lemma) | Hebrew | rejected | echo | lines (file 1 = o i 1–o iii 81).
